I told Pree in her #central-team thread that the settled seat count for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is 87.

I checked first that she's a member of #central-team, where both of Hollis's messages were posted. On Oct 14 he posted 268 seats, then corrected it to 87 the same day because he'd read the wrong line. My reply to Pree mentions that correction so the earlier 268 doesn't end up in the tracker.
